# ctyun_ebs_backup_policy_bind_disks (Resource)
-> 管理云硬盘和备份策略的绑定关系



## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ctyun = {
      source = "ctyun-it/ctyun"
    }
  }
}

# 可参考index.md，在环境变量中配置ak、sk、资源池ID、可用区名称
provider "ctyun" {
  env = "prod"
}

resource "ctyun_ebs_backup_policy_bind_disks" "test" {
  policy_id    = "a4b793881bbd42edaa6a0002900e5819"
  disk_id_list = "ae432721-61bf-45b7-b207-7e3256c1c2d6"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_id_list` (String) 云硬盘ID列表，多台使用英文逗号分割
- `policy_id` (String) 云硬盘备份策略id

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) 资源池ID，如果不填则默认使用provider ctyun中的region_id或环境变量中的CTYUN_REGION_ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID
## 导入

使用以下语法支持导入：

```shell
# 导入云硬盘备份策略绑定云硬盘
#[] 标记的参数为必填参数
#<> 标记的参数为可选参数,不填则取值环境变量值
terraform import ctyun_ebs_backup_policy_bind_disks.[导入配置名称] [policy_id],<region_id>
# 示例
terraform import ctyun_ebs_backup_policy_bind_disks.example b4d9a692-cd51-4a95-9769-492e237f148c,bb9fdb42056f11eda1610242ac110002
```
